anomalies.observed: U8 (74LVC1G34) is inserted between U4 pin 19 (SCL_1) and M3 pin 2 (TX/SCL). U8 pin 2 is connected to U4.19, U8 pin 4 is connected to M3.2 and R19.1. U8 is powered from +3V3 (pin 5).
anomalies.expected: Spec says U4 (EC isolator) connects directly to M3 (EZO-EC) on the isolated I2C bus. No buffer should be present. The isolated SCL line should be a direct bidirectional connection with a pull-up to /V_EC.

evidence.quote: U3 (pH) and U4 (EC) each present a secondary isolated I2C pair (/SDA_pH//SCL_pH, /SDA_EC//SCL_EC) that connects directly to M2 (EZO-pH) and M3 (EZO-EC) respectively

anomalies.impact: Breaks I2C bidirectionality and level compatibility; U8 input lacks pull-up, output drives against 5V pull-up, likely preventing EC sensor communication.

anomalies.observed: STDBY pins of all three TMC2209 drivers are left unconnected.
anomalies.expected: TMC2209 STDBY pin has internal pull-up and must be pulled low for normal operation. It should be tied to GND.
anomalies.impact: All three stepper drivers remain in standby mode, disabling motor outputs; dosing pumps will not run.

anomalies.observed: U5 MS1/AD0 and MS2/AD1 are unconnected. U6 MS1/AD0 is unconnected, MS2/AD1 is tied to +3V3. U7 MS1/AD0 and MS2/AD1 are tied to +3V3.
anomalies.expected: For a shared UART bus, each TMC2209 must have a unique address set by MS1/AD0 and MS2/AD1, typically tied to GND or VCC_IO. Floating pins are invalid.
anomalies.impact: UART addresses are undefined or conflicting, preventing proper UART communication with the drivers.
